blocks.text: This chapter presents David’s organization of Levites, priests, musicians, gatekeepers, and other servants as part of his preparation for Solomon’s temple work. The extensive lists therefore portray a planned ordering of people and responsibilities, not merely a collection of names.

The detailed orders that continue in the surrounding chapters may preserve earlier traditions while also reflecting and authorizing later temple institutions. For that reason, it is historically disputed whether every detail should be read as a direct record of one moment in David’s reign.

sections.title: A Note on the Ordered Lists
